name: Instant Noodle Pack Display
summary: Twenty plain pillow bags on a compact floor-standing hook rack for S06.
description: Original four-row retail rack with twenty puffy sealed bags, punched top-seal hang holes, continuous upturned steel hooks, a blank header and four blank price rails. Muted solid colours; no printed text, logos or real product packaging.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and three shared vertex-colour materials; no external models, images, fonts, textures or brands.
accuracy_notes: Static illustrative S06 P2 retail fixture. Generic solid-colour pillow bags and blank header/price rails; no readable text or real product packaging. No purchase interaction, flexible-film simulation or physical load certification. Full 17-shop scene integration, physical Android/iOS, WebKit and assembled-mall performance have not been tested.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry, vertex colours and shared materials. No external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
